commitMessage:
Group settings menu into collapsible categories

Settings are now organised as sub menus: My Account, Fleet (devices,
groups, drivers, geofences), Rules & Automation (notifications, saved
commands, maintenance, calendars, computed attributes), Business
(subscriptions, users, consents, announcements), System and Help.
Groups the user cannot use are hidden, the group with the current page
opens automatically, and open/closed state is remembered per device.
